question: Paramedics respond to a call regarding an 18-year-old male with severe sudden-onset heart palpitations. The patient reports symptoms of chest pain, fatigue, and dizziness. Upon examination, his heart rate is 175/min and regular. His blood pressure is 110/75 mm Hg. Gentle massage below the level of the left mandible elicits an immediate improvement in the patient, as his heart rate returns to 70/min. What was the mechanism of action of this maneuver?

options.opa: Increasing the refractory period in ventricular myocytes
options.opb: Increasing sympathetic tone in systemic arteries
options.opc: Decreasing the length of phase 4 of the SA node myocytes
options.opd: Slowing conduction in the AV node
options.ope: Decreasing the firing rate of carotid baroreceptors
